messages.content: Find me action movies that have David Leitch as the director and include Alex King in the cast?

function.name: Movies_3_FindMovies
function.description: Retrieves a list of movies based on the director, genre, and cast specified by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

directed_by.description: Director of the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the director is not a specific search criterion.

genre.description: Genre of the movie. Use 'dontcare' to include all genres or genre is not specified by user

cast.description: Names of leading actors or actresses in the movie. Use 'dontcare' if the cast is not a specific search criterion.

message.reasoning:

But check if there exist such movies. Let's think: David Leitch has directed films like John Wick series, Atomic Blonde, Deadpool 2 cameo? Actually he was co-director of Deadpool 1 but not main; also directed "The Last Full Measure"? Wait that's different. He hasn't directed many action movies starring Alex King. Alex King is an actor known for roles in "The Dark Knight Rises" etc. Did he appear in any David Leitch film? Possibly "Atomic Blonde" had some supporting role? Not sure. Maybe no matches. We should still query via function.

We'll use directed_by:"David Leitch". For genre, we could pass "Action" but it's not listed among allowed values. Allowed genres: Offbeat, Fantasy, World, Mystery, Thriller, Comedy, Comedy-drama, Horror, Animation, Sci-fi, Cult, Drama, Anime, Family, Action, dontcare. Yes Action exists. So set genre:"Action".
